حِمَآءٌ : see حِمًى. ＝
-A2- حِمَآءٌ لَكَ or حِمَآءً لَكَ i. q. فِدَآءٌ لَكَ [May such a person, or thing, be a ransom for thee!] or فِدَآءً لَكَ [meaning فُدِيتَ, i. e. mayest thou be ransomed!] or فَدَاكَ, i. e. may such a one ransom thee!]. (S, accord. to different copies.) [And in like manner,] the Arabs said, ↓ لَكَ الفِدَى وَالحِمَى [Ransom, or ransoming, be for thee!] pronouncing the former noun with the short alif when thus coupling it with الحِمَى. (El-Kálee, TA in art. فدى.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
